Special trip

Deserted Island 2 Days 1 Night

Trade Coron town for a quiet island for a night. This 2-day, 1-night diving package includes 5 dives and an overnight camp on an uninhabited island, arranged by the W Divers team.

Five dives and a night on the island.

The package includes five dives over the two days. Between dives you head to a quiet, uninhabited island, set up camp for the evening, and wake up on the beach before the next day on the water.

Know the arrangements.

Overnight trips need clear plans. Ask about sleeping arrangements, meals, drinking water, toilets and shade, what to bring, and what happens if the weather changes.

Who it suits.

Groups of friends, families, and divers travelling with non-divers. Mention everyone's interests when you inquire so the team can shape the two days.

At a glance

Format
Diving package with island camping
Length
2 days, 1 night
Dives
5 dives
Stay
Camping on an uninhabited island
Non-divers
Ask about snorkelling and beach time

Ask before you book

  • Which dive sites the 5 dives visit
  • Tents, bedding and what to bring
  • Meals and drinking water
  • Facilities on the island
  • Options for non-divers
  • Weather and cancellation terms
  • Total price
